_comment: One fixed model, three agents, ~3 samples per dataset: the smoke matrix that
answers 'does the whole pipeline work end to end, and what does it score?'
Every agent talks to the *same* vLLM server. Claude Code speaks the Anthropic
Messages API, which recent vLLM serves directly at /v1/messages; on older vLLM
put a LiteLLM proxy in front (see benchmarks/README.md) and set
ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL to the proxy. ANTHROPIC_API_KEY only has to be *set* -- the
local server ignores its value -- and nothing secret ever reaches the results.
Datasets: terminal-bench@2.0 is what the harbor registry currently publishes
(2.1 can be pinned as soon as it appears: `harbor datasets list --legacy`),
and swebench-verified is the 500-instance human-validated set. limit=3 keeps a
smoke run to nine agent runs per suite.
runtime='auto' means docker when there is a daemon, apptainer otherwise; pin it
to one of them when a comparison has to be byte-for-byte reproducible.

options._provider: derived per model: anthropic/ for the Claude Code model, openai/ otherwise
options._harbor_bin: the env that owns harbor; it must be the one with `pip install -e harbor`

models.name: ornith-35b-a3b
models.notes: vLLM on the H200: vllm serve ornith-ai/Ornith-1.5-35B-A3B --port 30000

models.name: ornith-35b-a3b-anthropic
models.notes: the same server over the Anthropic Messages API (/v1/messages); Claude Code speaks this
